title: sourceMappingURL includes full file path which breaks sourcemaps
impact: CLI only (the JS API returns the map separately and leaves the comment to the caller). 7 reactions, plus a second user in comments; earlier report #609 (closed, pointing here). Workaround: run the CLI from the output directory.
code: src/main.rs: main, ~L256 (map_filename = output_file + '.map' used both as the write path and as the URL)
summary: With `--sourcemap -o dist/out.css`, the CLI writes `/*# sourceMappingURL=dist/out.css.map */`. Browsers resolve the URL relative to the CSS file, so they look for dist/dist/out.css.map. With an absolute -o path, the absolute filesystem path is written into the CSS. The URL should be the map's file name only. Secondary: `sources` in the map are relative to the cwd (project root), not to the map's directory, so DevTools show paths off by the output dir (sourcesContent keeps it usable).
repro: 794-repro.mjs (runs the repo's target/release/lightningcss; CLI-only, so only `local` is meaningful). `lightningcss --bundle bundle.css -o dist/my-package.css --sourcemap` -> `sourceMappingURL=dist/my-package.css.map`; -o /abs/dist/x.css -> `sourceMappingURL=/abs/.../x.css.map`; -o out.css -> `out.css.map` (ok). Map: `"sources":["bundle.css","src/s.css"]` while map lives in dist/.
evidence: Ran the release CLI built from master (c6a0c3c) in a temp project with src/ and dist/. Code at src/main.rs:256-258 unchanged in releases since the flag was added (#68).

fix.approach: In src/main.rs, use output_file.file_name() + '.map' for the sourceMappingURL comment while still writing the map at the full path; optionally make `sources` relative to the output directory (or set sourceRoot). Add a CLI integration test for -o in a subdirectory.

openPRs.assessment: Closed without merge on 2026-10-15, no comments explaining why. Did the right fix (basename for the URL, full path for writing) and added a CLI integration test; did not touch `sources` paths. Could be reopened or used as reference.

draftReply:
Confirmed on the current version: with `-o dist/my-package.css --sourcemap`, the CLI writes `sourceMappingURL=dist/my-package.css.map`. Browsers resolve that relative to the CSS file, so the map isn't found. It should be just `my-package.css.map`, since the map is always written next to the output. With an absolute `-o` path, the absolute filesystem path ends up in the comment.

Until it's fixed, a workaround is to run the CLI from the output directory (e.g. `cd dist && lightningcss ../bundle.css -o my-package.css --sourcemap`), or to use the JS API, which returns the map separately so you can write the comment yourself. A PR that fixes this in `src/main.rs` with a test would be welcome.
